basic_details.short_information: The Jammu and Kashmir Public Service Commission (JKPSC) has released Notification No. 05-PSC(DR-P) OF 2026, dated 31-07-2026, inviting online applications for 205 posts of Assistant Professor (across 29 disciplines), College Director of Physical Education & Sports, and Librarian in Government Degree Colleges under the Higher Education Department, Jammu & Kashmir. Only domiciles of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir are eligible to apply.

application_fee.details: Fee must be paid online after successful submission of the application form. Applications submitted without fee payment reflected on the form are treated as incomplete and rejected without notice.

age_limit.details: Age is reckoned as on 1st January 2026. | Open Merit (OM): 40 years (not born after 01.01.2008, not born before 01.01.1986) Reserved categories: 43 years (not born after 01.01.2008, not born before 01.01.1983) In-service candidates/Government employees: 40 years (not born after 01.01.2008, not born before 01.01.1986) Physically Challenged: 42 years (not born after 01.01.2008, not born before 01.01.1982)

qualification.details: Eligibility varies by post. The core requirement for most Assistant Professor disciplines is a Master's degree with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/differently-abled candidates and PhD holders who obtained their Master's before 19 September 1991), along with NET/SLET/SET or an equivalent PhD under the applicable UGC regulations. Alternate routes exist for candidates with a PhD from a foreign university ranked in the world's top 500 (QS, THE, or ARWU). | Master's Degree with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Differently-abled categories or PhD holders who obtained their Master's degree prior to 19 September 1991), OR an equivalent point-scale grade from an Indian university or accredited foreign university, in a concerned/relevant/allied subject. Candidates must additionally have cleared NET (UGC/CSIR) or an equivalent SLET/SET test. Candidates who hold or have been awarded a PhD under UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil/PhD) Regulations 2009 or 2016 may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET, subject to conditions including: PhD awarded in regular mode by a recognized university; thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners; an open PhD viva voce conducted; at least two published research papers (one in a refereed journal); and at least two conference/seminar papers presented, certified by the Registrar or Dean (Academic Affairs) of the concerned university. Alternatively, a PhD from a foreign university/institution ranked in the world's top 500 by QS, THE, or ARWU (Shanghai) is also accepted. NET/SLET/SET is not required for Master's disciplines in which UGC/CSIR/similar bodies do not conduct these tests. | Same Master's-with-NET/PhD route as above in a relevant subject, OR Recognition as a traditional and professional artist of high standing, having studied under noted/reputed traditional masters, holding "A" grade artist status with AIR/Doordarshan, with the ability to explain the logical reasoning of the subject and adequate knowledge to teach theory with illustrations. | Master's Degree in a relevant subject with at least 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/Differently-abled candidates and PhD holders whose Master's was awarded before 19 September 1991), from an Indian university or an equivalent foreign degree. Must have cleared NET/SLET/SET, or hold a qualifying PhD under UGC 2009/2016 regulations (subject to the same conditions listed above), or hold a PhD from a foreign university ranked in the world's top 500 (QS/THE/ARWU). | Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science, or Documentation Science (or an equivalent professional degree) with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Differently-abled categories/PhD holders whose Master's was obtained before 19 September 1991), OR an equivalent point-scale grade. A consistently good academic record and knowledge of computerisation of libraries. Must have cleared NET (UGC/CSIR) or an equivalent SLET/SET, or hold a qualifying PhD under the applicable UGC regulations (subject to conditions similar to those listed for Assistant Professor). | Master's Degree in Physical Education and Sports, Physical Education, or Sports Science with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/Differently-abled categories), or an equivalent point-scale grade, AND a record of representing the university/college at inter-university/inter-collegiate competitions at state and/or national level. Must have cleared NET/SLET/SET, or hold a qualifying PhD (subject to conditions similar to those listed above for Assistant Professor). OR - an Asian Games or Commonwealth Games medal winner with at least a postgraduate degree. Candidates must also pass a physical fitness test conducted as per UGC Regulations 2018.

how_to_apply: Visit the official JKPSC website: jkpsc.nic.in.
Click on "One Time Registration" (OTR) if you are a new user, or "Login" if you already have a JKPSC profile.
Complete all required OTR fields - personal information, contact information, and educational qualification/service details.
Upload a recent date-stamped passport-size colour photograph (not taken earlier than 01.01.2025) and signature, each between 10KB and 20KB in JPEG/JPG format.
After submitting OTR details, check the eligibility conditions in the notification before applying for the post.
Click "show examination" against the relevant post/exam, select the month of the advertisement notification, and click the "APPLY" link.
Read the instruction window carefully, then click "APPLY" again.
Fill in any remaining required fields, accept the declaration, verify the details, and click "SUBMIT."
Pay the requisite fee online through the "Submitted Applications" menu in your account.
Upload the required documents to complete the final submission.
Download and keep a printout of the submitted application for future reference.
important_instructions: Applicants must possess a valid Domicile Certificate of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir; certificates issued after the closing date will not be entertained. Candidates claiming reservation must possess a valid category certificate on the cut-off date; false/fake/fraudulent claims will lead to debarment from JKPSC examinations. Candidates must carry a printout of the Admit Card/Roll Number Slip, at least two recent passport-size colour photographs (not taken earlier than 01.01.2026), and a valid original photo ID (Aadhaar/E-Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving Licence, PAN Card, Passport, School/College/University ID, or Employer ID) to the exam centre. Multiple applications using different registration IDs may lead to rejection; only the application with the higher Registration ID (RID) will be entertained. JKPSC does not undertake detailed scrutiny of eligibility at the time of the written exam; candidature is accepted only provisionally and is subject to verification at the document-verification stage.

faq.question: Q1. What is JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Jammu and Kashmir Public Service Commission, under Notification No. 05-PSC(DR-P) OF 2026 dated 31-07-2026, to fill 205 posts of Assistant Professor, College Director of Physical Education & Sports, and Librarian in Government Degree Colleges under the J&K Higher Education Department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in JKPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 205 total vacancies across 27 Assistant Professor disciplines plus Assistant Professor (Computer Application), College Director of Physical Education & Sports, and Librarian.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application, along with the requisite fee and documents, is 31-08-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for JKPSC Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Generally, a Master's degree with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/differently-abled/PhD holders pre-1991) in the relevant subject, along with NET/SLET/SET or an equivalent qualifying PhD. Requirements vary slightly by discipline - see the Eligibility Criteria section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 40 years for Open Merit and in-service/Government candidates, 43 years for reserved categories, and 42 years for Physically Challenged candidates, all reckoned as on 1st January 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 1,200 for General Category, Rs. 700 for Reserved Categories, and Nil for PHC candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online at jkpsc.nic.in through One Time Registration (OTR), followed by filling the application form, paying the fee, and uploading documents. See the "How to Apply" section above for the full step-by-step process.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a written examination of a single paper, 3 hours' duration, with 120 multiple-choice questions, conducted as per Rule 45 of the J&K PSC (Business & Procedure) Rules, 2021.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for JKPSC Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed at Pay Band Level-10 (Rs. 57,700 – Rs. 1,82,400).

faq.question: Q10. Is domicile required to apply for JKPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Only candidates who are domiciles of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir, and who possess a valid Domicile Certificate, are eligible to apply.
